name: Creators Death Game
original_name: クリエイターズ・デスゲーム
source: Indie game developer Suzuya, alongside a group of five other creatives, are trapped in a building by the mysterious exposé VTuber Anzai Moe and made to partake in a "Judgement Game", where each participant must collect evidence of each other's darkest secrets and expose them.
translation: Indie game developer Suzuya, alongside a group of five other creatives, are trapped in a building by the mysterious exposé VTuber Anzai Moe and made to partake in a "Judgement Game", where each participant must collect evidence of each other's darkest secrets and expose them.
